item.title: Mamasen
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Willow Soft
  • 発売日: 2010-12-24
  • スコア: 6.859999999999999/10 (48 人評価)
  • 日本語名: まません
  • 英語名: Mamasen

あらすじ

The hero has lived with his father in the wilderness for most of his life, strengthening his body and learning various fighting techniques. This has left the hero somewhat naïve in relation to social norms. Suddenly, his father remarries and leaves the hero with his new mother and two sisters. He is enrolled at the school where his mother and sisters work and his new life begins.

  • 発売日: 2009-12-25

  • 日本語名: お母さんがいっぱい!
  • 英語名: Okaa-san ga Ippai!

别名

  • OkaIpa

あらすじ

Kazuki doesn’t have his parents. His father passed away before and his mother went missing…. One day, his grand-father picks up seven stepmother candidates including famous actress, female doctor and so on…. They all come to his house to be his mother! Sometimes severe and sometimes tender…. His life with seven mothers starts now….

  • 日本語名: 茉莉子さん家の性事情～伯母さんは僕のモノ～
  • 英語名: Mariko-sanchi no Seijijou Oba-san wa Boku no Mono

あらすじ

The main character is Takeru. His parents are now abroad and he temporarily lives at his uncle’s house. His uncle rarely comes back home, but he enjoys his life there with Mariko, his aunt, and Akine, her daughter. He, however, gradually falls in love with Mariko though he knows it is forbidden. One day, he accidentally sees Mariko masturbating. He can’t control his libido anymore and finally sleeps with Mariko….
